summary.text: Kasey Carpenter is a Republican state representative from Georgia House District 4 who has served since November 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a restaurant owner and chairs the House Creative Arts & Entertainment Committee.

paragraphs.text: Carpenter received a bachelor's degree in finance from the University of Georgia and, as of January 2020, lived in Dalton, Georgia.
His career experience includes working as a restaurant owner.
Carpenter assumed office in the Georgia House on November 20, 2017, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Appropriations Committee, the Industry and Labor Committee, the House Higher Education Committee, the Regulated Industries Committee, the House Transportation Committee and the Ways and Means Committee, and he chairs the Creative Arts & Entertainment Committee.
